question: How many customers are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers

question: List all genre names.
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM genres

question: What is the name of the longest track by duration? Return only the track name.
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM tracks ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many albums are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM albums

question: How many employees are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees

question: Which artist has the most tracks? Return only the artist name.
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name FROM artists ar JOIN albums al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId JOIN tracks t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which country has the most customers? Return only the country.
gold_sql: SELECT Country FROM customers GROUP BY Country ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the total invoice revenue by billing country? Return the country and the total.
gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry, SUM(Total) FROM invoices GROUP BY BillingCountry

question: How many tracks belong to the Rock genre?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tracks t JOIN genres g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Rock'

question: What is the average track length in seconds?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(Milliseconds) / 1000.0 FROM tracks

question: Which artist generated the highest revenue from track sales? Return only the artist name.
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name FROM invoice_items ii JOIN tracks t ON t.TrackId = ii.TrackId JOIN albums al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN artists ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What are the top 5 genres by revenue? Return the genre name and revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS revenue FROM invoice_items ii JOIN tracks t ON t.TrackId = ii.TrackId JOIN genres g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which customers spent more than the average customer? Return first and last names.
gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId HAVING SUM(i.Total) > (SELECT AVG(s) FROM (SELECT SUM(Total) AS s FROM invoices GROUP BY CustomerId))

question: Which employee supports the most customers? Return first and last name.
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName FROM employees e JOIN customers c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which albums have more than 20 tracks? Return the album titles.
gold_sql: SELECT al.Title FROM albums al JOIN tracks t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId GROUP BY al.AlbumId HAVING COUNT(*) > 20

question: How many invoices were issued in 2010?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoices WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2010'

question: What is the total invoice revenue for each year? Return the year and the total.
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate), SUM(Total) FROM invoices GROUP BY strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate)

question: How many tracks have no composer listed?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tracks WHERE Composer IS NULL

question: List the first and last names of customers from the United States.
gold_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM customers WHERE Country = 'USA'

question: What is the average invoice total for each billing country, only for countries with more than 10 invoices? Return the country and average.
gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry, AVG(Total) FROM invoices GROUP BY BillingCountry HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
